_about: RMT Solutions' price book: the only place a quote price comes from. A price of null means the service is priced per job: the quote spec must carry Ricky's figure for that job, or the quote is refused. Never fill a null with a guess. Prices are ex VAT, in pounds. Anything listed in 'unconfirmed' is held back from issued quotes until Ricky confirms it and removes it from the list.
standard_inclusions: A fixed price: no hourly billing and no surcharge you have not agreed in advance.
Revisions arising from the principal contractor's review, and support with the resubmission until it is accepted.
Checked and signed off by our CPCS A61 Appointed Person before it is issued.

services.name: Excavator lift plan
scope: Site-specific lift plan to BS 7121 and LOLER 1998, written remotely from your information
Duty from the manufacturer's published lifting capacity for the exact machine and configuration
Elevation and plan drawings to the machine's real dimensions, with the rigging and exclusion zone
info_needed: Machine make and model, with the quick-hitch and lifting point
Load description and weight
Site plan or marked-up photos showing the lift area
Lifting accessories to be used
Ground conditions and any nearby services or overhead lines

services.name: Telehandler lift plan
scope: Site-specific lift plan to BS 7121 and LOLER 1998, written remotely from your information
Capacity from the manufacturer's load chart for the exact machine and attachment
Drawings of each movement: unloading, travel and placing, with set-up positions and exclusion zones
info_needed: Telehandler make and model, and the attachment (forks, hook, jib)
Load description and weight
Site plan showing delivery point, route and placing position
Ground conditions along the route

services.name: Forklift lift plan
scope: Site-specific lift plan to LOLER 1998, written remotely from your information
Capacity from the manufacturer's data plate and load centre for the exact truck
Plan drawing of the route, set-down areas and exclusion zones
info_needed: Forklift make and model, and capacity at load centre
Load description, weight and dimensions
Site plan showing the route and set-down area

services.name: Lorry loader (HIAB) lift plan
scope: Site-specific lift plan to BS 7121, LOLER 1998 and ALLMI guidance, written remotely from your information
Capacity from the manufacturer's published duty for the exact lorry loader
Elevation, plan and rigging drawings showing stabilisers, mats and every leg of the rigging
info_needed: Lorry loader make and model (or the hire company and vehicle)
Load description, weight and lifting points
Site plan or photos showing the vehicle position and landing point
Ground conditions under the stabilisers
Any overhead lines or buried services nearby

services.name: Mobile crane lift plan, site visit included
scope: Site visit by the Appointed Person to assess the set-up, ground and surroundings
Lift plan to BS 7121 and LOLER 1998, with the duty read from the manufacturer's published chart for the exact configuration
Elevation, plan, rigging and 3D drawings, with outrigger loads and mat bearing
info_needed: Load description, weight and lifting points
Proposed crane, or the hire company if you want us to select it
Site plan and the lift date
Any ground investigation information you hold

services.name: Tower crane lift plan, site visit included
scope: Site visit by the Appointed Person
Lift plan to BS 7121 and LOLER 1998 from the manufacturer's published load chart
info_needed: Tower crane make, model, jib length and base
Loads to be lifted, with weights
Site plan showing the crane position and oversail

services.name: Overhead gantry crane lift plan
scope: Lift plan to BS 7121 and LOLER 1998 for the overhead crane and the load
info_needed: Crane SWL and the latest thorough examination report
Load description, weight and lifting points
Layout of the bay and the travel route

services.name: Tandem or multi-crane lift plan
scope: Tandem lift plan to BS 7121-1 Section 14, with de-rating and load-share checks
Site visit where the operation needs one
info_needed: Both cranes, or the hire company
Load weight, centre of gravity and lifting points
Site plan and the lift date

services.name: Lift plan review (19-point, CAT A / CAT B)
scope: 19-point review against BS 7121, LOLER 1998 and the manufacturer's data
A clear CAT A approved or CAT B rejected outcome
Every finding with the change needed to close it, ready to paste into the resubmission
info_needed: The lift plan with its drawings
The RAMS or method statement
Duty or load charts used
LOLER thorough examination certificates and operator competence cards

services.name: Method statement / RAMS
scope: Method statement and risk assessment for the work package, written to the site's facts
info_needed: Scope of work and programme
Site address and principal contractor
Plant and equipment to be used

services.name: Steel erection lift plan and sequence
scope: Erection sequence from the steel model, with each lift checked against the crane's published duty
Lift plan and drawings for the sequence
info_needed: Steel GA and marking plans, or the fabricator's model (IFC or Tekla)
Proposed crane and MEWPs
Programme

services.name: Appointed Person site attendance
scope: CPCS A61 Appointed Person attending site for the lifting operation
info_needed: Site address, dates and start time
The lift plan for the operation

services.name: Lifting operations audit
scope: Site audit of lifting operations against BS 7121 and LOLER 1998, with a written report
info_needed: Site address and the lifting equipment in use
Current lift plans and thorough examination records

services.name: Aerial and ground site survey
scope: Drone and ground-level photography of the site in one visit
info_needed: Site address and access arrangements
Any airspace restrictions you are aware of

services.name: Out-of-hours working (evenings or weekends), as agreed
scope: Work carried out in the evening or at the weekend at your request, agreed before it starts
